title: Admin password stored in plaintext at /data/data/com.acer.android.m3.webserver/shared_prefs/userInfo.xml, allowing any…
description: An admin password is stored in plaintext within the file /data/data/com.acer.android.m3.webserver/shared_prefs/userInfo.xml. This allows any application with root or file access on the device to read the credentials directly, potentially compromising administrative control.
